visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a thick, vibrant pink syrup containing fruit chunks being poured from a glass pitcher into a light pink paper cup. The background is a slightly blurred stainless steel countertop. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a young woman with short brown hair, wearing a green t-shirt, a face mask, and a brown apron with a 'Mu Cha Tea' logo. She is behind a wooden counter in a brightly lit shop, unpacking a large plastic bag filled with white cups. (3) A close-up shows a large white cup filled with a bright pink iced drink topped with crushed ice. A hand holds the cup. (4) The camera focuses on the preparation process: pink syrup is poured into a measuring beaker, then into a cup. Yellow lemon juice is added. A metal slotted spoon scoops translucent, spherical jellies and drops them into the pink drink. (5) In a tall clear plastic bottle with a 'Mu Cha Tea' label, white milk is poured over a layer of dark pink fruit syrup, creating a swirling effect. (6) Another beverage is shown being made: tea is poured from a metal shaker over ice into a white cup containing pink peach syrup. (7) A close-up shows a ladle pouring dark brown sugar syrup into a bottle, followed by white milk being poured in, creating marbling patterns on the sides of the bottle. (8) A hand operates a stainless steel tea dispenser tap, filling a metal cup with dark tea. The tea is then poured into a cup with ice and black grass jelly. (9) The final scene shows the exterior of the 'Mu Cha Tea' shop with a white sign and pink banners. Text overlays provide the address and a food blog handle.
